title: Corporate Loan Securitization and the Standardization of Financial Covenants

scopes.description: The authors’ full documented dataset preparation and reported main/appendix workflow, beginning at BLV_code.do and including manual inputs and handoffs that the supplied program leaves external.

requirements.description: Author-named CLO-i monthly U.S. CLO holdings input holdingsTOTAL_original.dta (author version as of June 2013). Code expects deal/issuer/loan-type/maturity/date/balance and related ratings/industry fields; complete observation period and author field mapping are not supplied.

requirements.description: CLOperformance.dta and CLO_trades.dta feed monthly performance merges and CLO-quarter trade/turnover variables. The code needs performance, thresholds, default and trade-amount fields, with prior-quarter coverage for lagged controls; dates/history are unknown.

routes.description: The author docs identify CLO performance and trading activity as CLO-i data and the code labels June 2013 version. These exact files and required columns are not supplied or matched to a current product route.

requirements.description: DealScan inputs used for facility/package matching, controls, lender shares, market segment, loan histories, and author-specific Chava-Roberts files: facilityid.dta, packageid.dta, lendershares.dta, mkt_segment.dta, and DealAmt.dta. Required fields in BLV_code.do include FacilityID/PackageID, Company/Country, LoanType, maturity and origination dates, FacilityAmount/FacilityAmt, allindrawn, gvkey, borrowerid/lenderid, lead_bank, and DealAmount; exact source-to-author file mappings and versions are unresolved. Loan relationships also need earlier records within a 1,800-day window.

routes.description: Bounded one-row probes establish readability and these candidate source columns only: facility has FacilityID, PackageID, Company, LoanType, FacilityStartDate, FacilityEndDate, FacilityAmt, Secured, CountryOfSyndication; package has PackageID, BorrowerCompanyID, Company, DealActiveDate, DealAmount; lender shares has FacilityID, CompanyID, Lender, LenderRole, BankAllocation, AgentCredit, LeadArrangerCredit; market segment has FacilityID, MarketSegment. These are not the author DTA files and do not establish all code fields or history.

requirements.description: Manual securitized-at-origination annotation and author sample file securitized_packages.dta, including the package-level securitized flag and at_origination indicator. The code uses this as input but the workbook/annotations and producer are not packaged.

LoanConnector values for initial rating, secured status and, in Appendix Tables 6–7, lead-arranger loan share; the appendix permits manual contract collection of arranger share where LoanConnector has no value. Required loan/facility linkage, product version, sample coverage and fallback procedures are not supplied.

issues.description: The code requires manual CLO-i/DealScan false-match cleanup, additional Excel matching, securitized-at-origination flags and complete-contract/covenant collection. The package has no matching workbook, manual corrections or prepared outputs; ID_borrowerid.txt is an identifier list, not the underlying analysis data.

The local catalog hits are discovery candidates only. Bounded DealScan probes expose source names such as FacilityAmt/CountryOfSyndication and Lender/CompanyID, while the author files expect a different set of fields; the Compustat candidate has fyear/sich where the Stata code uses year/sic. The LoanConnector candidate is only an ID crosswalk. Exact author file versions, mappings, transformations and coverage remain unverified.

Static dependency discovery missed direct reads of [redacted-path-18f983015b6c] and [redacted-path-f841d942d98e]. The frozen D0017 syndicates.dta read also has no producer/save step in the supplied code. Their origin, expected fields and compatible preparation routes are not documented.

The do-file creates separate outputs such as covenant_similarity_score.dta, packageid_add.dta and avg_sim.dta, but does not show how these are merged into the final loan/CLO analysis inputs; the later loan branch reads similarity_loan.dta and only merges Compustat. Comments refer to subsequent merging and 1% winsorization that are not implemented here. No final analysis entry point or output schema for the reported tables is supplied.

The Internet Appendix reports Tables 1–8 and Figures 1–2, but the package contains no executable analysis programs for these branches. Appendix methods mention matching, legal-content/LSTA comparisons, arranger ownership, the CLO 2.0 indicator and Roberts-Sufi covenant-violation event sales; required programs, variable producers and supporting data are not provided. These are clarification leads, not reconstructed requirements.

The code requires five preceding Compustat cash-flow rows, prior loan history within 1,800 days with additional backward iterations, and prior CLO quarters for lags. Only a 2000–2009 origination sample is documented; raw-input histories, exact first/last years, and gaps are unknown, so no start date or completeness can be inferred.

The author code uses hard-coded [redacted-path-7503566e2f51] paths throughout and provides no data-root mapping or portable project configuration. The intended runtime layout and files to overwrite/create must be clarified before an authorized attempt.

The CLO performance input is collapsed to senior_oc, junior_oc, ccc_bucket and defaultpct by deal/month, then merged into holdingsTOTAL; the next two lines calculate senior_oc_score and junior_oc_score from senior_oc_threshold and junior_oc_threshold. The earlier holdingsTOTAL collapse also retains only its listed fields, which exclude both thresholds. No producer or merge of either threshold variable is shown. The authors must identify the correct source columns, keys and stage; do not invent values or edit either collapse list without confirmation.
